pr_title: Enable the same name for alarm and dimension
pr_body:
##### Summary
Fixes #7670 
Fixes #7834 

Netdata was using one index for `RRDVAR`s  in two different places of the code, this did not allow us to have variables with the same name, but our documentation did not define that this is not possible. This PR brings another index to fix this ancient bug.
##### Component Name
Health
##### Additional Information
I used the following alarm to test :

```
 alarm: user
      on: system.cpu
    calc: $user
   every: 10s
    crit: $this != 1
   units: processes
   delay: up 1m down 5m multiplier 1.5 max 1h
      to: sysadmin
```

I also use normal alarms to confirm that nothing was break.

##### Bug report summary
In the issue #7670 the user described a bug that was present on Netdata, but after an investigation it was identified that there was an ancient bug affecting other areas on Netdata that needs to be fixed.

/etc/os-release:NAME=Slackware

##### Netdata version
netdata v1.19.0-379-g129c57e2
 

##### Component Name
Health
##### Steps To Reproduce
Set dimension and alarm with the same name.
##### Expected behavior
Enable users to give any name for alarms.
